## Fixes

- Detect TypeScript aliases that resolve to `unknown` through union members, including alias chains.
- Unslop's strict preset now flags only clusters of contrast reframes by default, allowing isolated contrasts while honoring explicit `max` overrides.
- Unbold respects whitespace-only and CRLF blank lines when matching bold delimiters, and keeps indented backticks and tildes from opening or closing fenced code blocks.
- Release preparation validates all metadata replacements before writing any files, leaving inputs unchanged when validation fails.
